items.title: ROSEN, A TOP-RANKED AND TRUSTED LAW FIRM, Encourages Duolingo, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - DUOL
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Duolingo, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased Class A common stock between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Duolingo made materially false statements regarding Daily Active User growth, failed to disclose that increased user friction from ads and subscription upsells was negatively impacting DAU growth, and that low-quality AI-generated content was degrading the product experience. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 7, 2026.

items.title: Kaplan Fox Alerts Investors of Duolingo, Inc. (NASDAQ: DUOL) to a Pending Securities Class Action – Deadline is December 7, 2026
items.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Duolingo on behalf of investors who purchased stock between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026. The complaint alleges that Duolingo made false and misleading statements about the negative impact of increased ad volume, subscription upsells, and AI-generated content on daily active user growth. The stock experienced significant drops following disappointing financial results and the CFO's departure, with declines of 25%, 8.5%, and 14% on respective dates in late 2025 and early 2026.

items.title: Duolingo Shareholder Alert: ClaimsFiler Reminds Investors With Losses In Excess Of $100,000 Of Lead Plaintiff Deadline In Class Action Lawsuit Against Duolingo, Inc. - DUOL
items.summary: Duolingo is facing a securities class action lawsuit alleging that the company and its executives failed to disclose that they deliberately added friction to the user experience through increased ads, subscription upselling, and declining product quality to drive users away. The lawsuit also claims that Duolingo's AI-generated content was degrading product quality and harming user retention, contrary to public statements about growth and improvements. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 have until December 7, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.
